mechanism: Base.UpdateGame1 maps held ArrowLeft to moveMap(+50,0) and ArrowRight to moveMap(-50,0); Base.moveMap shifts graphics; these are camera-only inputs and not click-to-attack.

static_source.core.Base.startMapDrag: supports camera movement with mouse drag, independent from intentional unit selection
static_source.core.Base.moveMap: updates topX/topY and moves object displays; triggers no direct attack request
static_source.core.isoengine.IsoEngine.getNearestTarge: uses unit arrays, tile-coordinate distance and eligibility; does not read viewport position directly within target-scoring helper
static_source.source_caveat: Static target-scoring method alone cannot rule out viewport-dependent object activation elsewhere in the engine.
